mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT equip_name FROM condition_controller WHERE use_yn = 'Y' AND equip_name != '' ORDER BY equip_name
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO condition_controller (calib_year, equip_name, zone_name, std_temp, meas_temp, deviation, reg_user_name) VALUES (#{calibYear}, #{equipName}, #{zoneName}, #{stdTemp}, #{measTemp}, #{deviation}, #{regUserName})
mapper.update: UPDATE condition_controller SET calib_year = #{calibYear}, equip_name = #{equipName}, zone_name = #{zoneName}, std_temp = #{stdTemp}, meas_temp = #{measTemp}, deviation = #{deviation}, upd_dt = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE condition_controller SET use_yn = 'N', upd_dt = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
